summary: Fire tower at Wagner Lake, Itasca County, MN; the Forest Lookouts list says it was removed in 1976 and FFLA marks it gone. No source found describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1976, per the Forest Lookouts Minnesota list; the FFLA Minnesota list also marks it gone

events.note: Tower removed, per the Forest Lookouts Minnesota list

evidence.supports: tower in Itasca County, section 1 of township 149N, range 28W
FFLA lists Wagner Lake as a tower, marked gone, at 47.75539 -94.16396

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts list gives only location and the 1976 removal; no build date, builder, design, height or fire record found in any source. Two WebSearch calls returned only a different Wagner Lake in Wright County and an unrelated tower near Pittsburg, neither used. Story is about 82 words, under the 120-word floor, because the evidence supports no more; not padded. Consider holding for a fuller FFLA catalogue check before publishing.
